name: id
description: The ledger entry's document id (the trigger's event id), or bf:{uid}:{qid} for a backfilled answer — the streaming insertId and the reconcile's key

name: surface
description: daily · feed · test · learn · pulse · call — null on a row the reconcile appended from a ledger entry, which carries none

name: option_idx
description: The chosen option; null for a catalogue pick or a rank answer

name: from_idx
description: Present only on a D86 edit: the option the answer moved away from

name: answered_at
description: When the row was appended (the trigger's clock) or the ledger's own `at` on a reconciled row; the answer document's answeredAt on a backfilled row

name: anchors
description: The frozen cohort chips the fold used (D8, D410's honest set) — null where the ledger carried none
